tagline: An established specialty pharmacy with long-term care contracts
overview: Project Drift is an independent specialty pharmacy in Ontario serving long-term care homes, retirement residences and community patients. It runs compliance packaging, compounding and delivery from a well-equipped dispensary, and a lead pharmacist and experienced technicians run the day-to-day work.

highlights.title: Recurring care-home business
highlights.detail: Most dispensing repeats every month under multi-year service agreements.

highlights.title: Compounding capability
highlights.detail: An in-house compounding lab serves prescriptions few community pharmacies can fill.

highlights.title: Experienced team
highlights.detail: Long-tenured pharmacists and technicians stay with the business.

highlights.title: Room in the lease
highlights.detail: The premises have space for more packaging lines without moving.

highlights.title: Clean books
highlights.detail: Accountant-reviewed statements with a clear normalization.

growth.title: More care homes
growth.detail: Nearby homes are looking for a pharmacy partner with packaging capacity.

growth.title: Clinic services
growth.detail: Vaccinations and medication reviews can grow with the current team.

growth.title: Virtual care
growth.detail: Delivery already covers a wide area, so online refills could add volume.

whoItSuits: A pharmacy group adding long-term care capacity
A pharmacist-owner ready to step into a running business
transition: The owner stays as designated manager until the new one is approved
managementNote: A lead pharmacist with long tenure runs long-term care dispensing, supported by a compounding pharmacist and a stable technician team.

listingPhrases.supportTraining: The owner stays through the handover
